excerpt.zh: 在击败了[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]之后，我们认为在[Target.GetName]上举办一场以我们收获的[Root.GetTrophyName]为主题的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]对我们的帝国多有裨益。
excerpt.en: After defeating the [This.GetLeviathanTargetName], we believe that a [Owner.GetParadeStudy] on [Target.GetName] focusing on the [Root.GetTrophyName] we secured would be very beneficial to our empire.

texts.zh: 在击败了[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]之后，我们认为在[Target.GetName]上举办一场以我们收获的[Root.GetTrophyName]为主题的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]对我们的帝国多有裨益。
texts.en: After defeating the [This.GetLeviathanTargetName], we believe that a [Owner.GetParadeStudy] on [Target.GetName] focusing on the [Root.GetTrophyName] we secured would be very beneficial to our empire.

sections.zh: 在[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]污染被清理干净之前，我们的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]暂停举办。
sections.en: This [Owner.GetParadeStudy] is on hold until the [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] contamination can cleaned up.

texts.zh: 为了准备那个重要的日子，我们将一颗以太巨龙的獠牙转运到[Target.GetName]。把它们塞进货运飞船是一项极富挑战的工作，以太巨龙独特的生理构造似乎违背了物理法则。在进入[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]大气层时，獠牙对飞船发生了极其奇怪的反应：它在众目睽睽之下开始瓦解，要不是飞船快速应对，我们可能就会失去这一宝贵的物品。
texts.en: In preparation for the big day, we have transferred one of the Ether Drake's Fangs to [Target.GetName]. Getting them into the transport ship was a challenge, as the Ether Drake's unique biology does not seem to follow the laws of physics. The fang reacted particularly strangely to the transport ship entering the [Target.GetPlanetHabitat]'s atmosphere: it began unraveling before us, and if the transport ship hadn't responded quickly, we might have lost the coveted artifact.

label.zh: 建造一个更好的容器，把獠牙带下来。
label.en: Construct a better container and bring the fang down.

label.zh: 这奇怪的反应可比[Owner.GetParadeStudy]好玩多了。
label.en: This reaction is much more interesting than any [Owner.GetParadeStudy].

tooltips.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以展开对反应的研究。
tooltips.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of studying the reaction.

label.en: Replace the fang with a replica.

tooltips.zh: 这将会降低该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will reduce the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

texts.zh:
摘取裂爪龙之眼是一项混乱不堪的工程，开始阶段错误百出。幸运的是，这只巨兽有许多只眼睛让我们逐一试错。我们将这只眼睛拖到了[Target.Solar_System.GetName]以后发生一件又奇妙又恶心的事情：这只眼睛迅速地黏住了当地的传感阵列，并将自己牢牢地嵌在上面，俯视着[Target.GetName]。事件的起因还在调查当中，但需要重申，这只巨龙的许多生理学知识仍是我们未知的。

眼睛还没有和恒星基地完全融为一体，但我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为如果我们想继续进行之前的计划，就必须阻止这个状况。
texts.en:
The extraction of the Shard's Eye was a messy process with a few false starts. Luckily, the behemoth had a lot of eyes for us to practice on. We then towed the optic to [Target.Solar_System.GetName], and something both fascinating and revolting happened: the oculus started attaching and integrating itself into the local sensor array overlooking [Target.GetName]. The cause of this is unknown, but then again, much of the Drake's physiology is beyond us.

The fusing is not complete yet, but our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe it has to be halted now if we wish to proceed with our previous plans.

label.zh: 让我们用裂爪龙之眼审视世界吧。
label.en: Let us see with the sight of The Shard!

tooltips.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以把这只眼睛用于其他用途。
tooltips.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of using the eye for a different purpose.

label.zh: 快把它抠下来，最后期限要到了！
label.en: Scrape it off, we have deadlines to reach.

tooltips.zh: 这将会降低该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will reduce the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.zh: 小心地把它取下来，我们可不想有什么磕碰。
label.en: Very carefully remove it, we wouldn't want to damage it.

texts.zh:
无畏战舰反应堆在运抵[Target.GetName]之前一直是一个超级乖乖的货物，抵达后我们将其安置在一处仓库内以待那一天的到来。这下问题就来了：在无人照看的情况下，这台反应堆突然自己重启了。反应堆迸射出巨大的等离子电弧，整座仓库由内而外发出耀眼的光，整座建筑似乎很快就要被熔化了。

我们[Owner.GetScientistPlural]反应迅速，力挽狂澜，于是现在我们就有了一台运转中的反应堆了。
texts.en:
The Dreadnought's Reactor was a very well-behaved cargo until it arrived at [Target.GetName], where we placed it in a warehouse awaiting its big day. It was there the troubles began: while no one was looking, the reactor restarted itself. The warehouse was lit up from within as it spouted out huge arcs of plasma, threatening to melt down the entire building.

The quick actions of our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] were just sufficient to save it in the nick of time, with the upshot that we now have an active reactor to do with as we please.

label.en: Attach it to the [Target.GetPlanetHabitat]'s power grid.
Incorporate it into the performance.

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.en: Find the off-switch

texts.zh: 即便我们预警了外星污染的危险，但还是有东西搞砸了。族母的鞭毛运入[Target.GetName]首都时，它以某种方式接触了其中一个管运者，然后几乎是瞬间，它就发生了变化。这件战利品上长出了脉动的附肢，变成了一团搅动的肉质。慢慢地它逐渐细化，然后竟然长成了那个被接触的管运者的模样！似乎是族母的再生能力接纳了我们物种的基因，并开始产出更多的[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
texts.en: Even with our xeno-contamination precautions, something went wrong. As the Matriarch's Flagella entered [Target.GetName]'s capital, it somehow got in contact with one of the handlers, and instantly, the flagella started reacting. Pulsating ripping appendages began growing from the Trophy, first forming an indistinct churning mass of flesh. Over time it became more detailed, and to our surprise, it assumed the shape of the unfortunate handler! It seems like the regenerative powers of the Matriarch have accepted the DNA of our kind and are now in the process of generating more [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

label.zh: 让围观者也一起尝尝这个！
label.en: Use this to feed the onlookers!

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.en: Let the reaction run its course.
Cauterize the Flagella.

tooltips.zh: 这将会降低该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will reduce the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.en: Xenophile

texts.zh: 将天空龙羽翼带回家的时候，我们的货运飞船发现他们经过的超空间航道发生了二次扭曲。期限认为只是普通的异常现象而忽视了，直到飞船进入[Target.Solar_System.GetName]时才发现，有一团追逐着飞船的实体导致了超空间航道膨胀：一窝龙的幼崽热切追逐着我们的货运飞船，从中鱼贯而出进入我们的星系。他们应该是躲藏在跳跃点附近跟随者我们出来航道的。这些小龙似乎没有它们亲代的智力，而是漫无目的地跟随着我们——确切地说是跟随着羽翼。
texts.en: While carrying home the Sky Dragon's Plume, our transportation ship noticed that the hyperlane they traveled through had a second distortion beyond their ship. Initially disregarding this as just an anomaly, it was not apparent until the ship entered [Target.Solar_System.GetName] that a group of pursuing entities was causing the hyperlane-dilation: a clutch of dragon whelps exited into our system in hot pursuit of our transport ship. They must have lain in hiding near the jump point and followed our exit. The dragonlings do not seem to possess the mental faculties of their progenitor and seem to be aimlessly following us or, more particularly, the plume.

label.en: Kill the pests.

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

tooltips.zh: 这将会降低该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will reduce the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.zh: 我们得在[Target.Solar_System.GetName]为他们设立一个栖息地。
label.en: We should set up a sanctuary for them in [Target.Solar_System.GetName].

tooltips.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以开辟一颗小行星让幼崽居住。
tooltips.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of giving an asteroid for the whelplings to inhabit.

label.en: Xenophobe

label.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]还迎来了一群活体成员该有多好！
label.en: Imagine having live subjects for the [Owner.GetParadeStudy]!

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.en: Egalitarian
Xenophobe

label.zh: 警告性开火，把它们吓跑！
label.en: Fire some warning shots, drive them off!

texts.zh: 今天早晨，在[Target.GetName]上有个惊喜等着我们，拾荒机器人压缩机在我们的储存设施里吐出了最后一块它的作品。这一大块合金比我们所能想象所能产出的最致密的合金还要紧实，仅需数立方米就可以建造出一整艘战列舰。这一喜出望外的发展让我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信他们有希望让压缩机以0.001%的功率重新运作。
texts.en: This morning, a surprise awaited us on [Target.GetName] as the Scavenger Bot's Compactor deposited the last of its creations in our storage facility. The large chunk of alloys was denser and more compact than anything we could ever hope to produce, containing enough metals in a few cubic meters to build an entire battleship. This fantastic development has our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] believing that they can get the compactor working again at 0.001% efficiency, if we should wish it.

label.zh: 把它拆了用来造点东西。
label.en: Break it apart and use it for construction.
Incorporate into the [Owner.GetParadeStudy].

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.zh: 把压缩机丢回太空运转。
label.en: Return the Compactor to space and let it work.

tooltips.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以重新激活压缩机，在[Target.GetName]的轨道上制造£alloys£ +10矿藏。
tooltips.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of reactivating the compactor and gaining a £alloys£ +10 deposit in orbit of [Target.GetName].

texts.zh:
星际幽魂散发器囊这发出的斑驳光芒看起来格外引人注目，以至于让人差点没发现这个幽魂用来产生护盾的囊发生了泄露。在快速确认里面的化学物质不会导致[Target.GetName]生态系统崩溃之后，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]专注于分析这些气体对我们大气的影响。

似乎这些泄露的化学物质已经混入了我们大气的中间层，正在高效地散发其中凝聚的能量。如果我们继续散发其中的物质，它甚至可以有效地提高我们行星的防御能力。
texts.en:
The strobing lights of the Stellar Wraith's Disperser Sack were distracting to look upon, so distracting that it took a while to detect that the sack the Wraith used to generate its natural shield was leaking. After quickly confirming that exposure to the chemicals inside would not cause a total ecological collapse on [Target.GetName], our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] focused on analyzing the effects the gas had on our atmosphere.

It seems like the emitted chemicals have fused with our mesosphere and disperse concentrated energies surprisingly well. So well that if we release the rest of the disperser's contents, there would be a noticeable increase in planetary defensiveness.

label.zh: 把里面的气体抽出来完成反应。
label.en: Extract the rest of the gas and let the reaction finish.

tooltips.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以将[Target.GetName]的向大气灌输幽魂散布器囊。
tooltips.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of infusing [Target.GetName]'s atmosphere with the Wraith's Disperser Sack.

label.en: Plug it up.
Incorporate it into the performance.

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

texts.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural]向[Target.Solar_System.GetName]汇报了运输恐怖负相物质的货运飞船上的奇怪的现象。我们被包括通向纯粹苦痛与毁灭低语的世界窗口之类的恼人的幻想所袭扰。据信原因就是[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]的团块，我们有理由担忧如果将船上的这玩意带到[Target.GetName]到底会发生什么。
texts.en: Our [Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural] have been reporting strange activity on the ship transporting the Horrific Inverse Mass to [Target.Solar_System.GetName]. Windows into worlds of pure pain and whispers of destruction are just a few of the disturbing accounts we have received. It's believed that the mass of the [This.GetLeviathanTargetName] is to blame, and we might rightfully worry what would happen if we were to bring the ship's cargo to [Target.GetName].

label.en: Return it to whence it came.

tooltips.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以保护[Target.GetName]上[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的安全和精神健康。
tooltips.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of protecting the safety and sanity of the [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [Target.GetName].

label.en: Materialist
No! We need to study this.

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.en: Spiritualist

label.zh: 包好它，我不希望这个现象散布开去。
label.en: Contain it, we can't let this phenomenon spread.

label.zh: 它可以赐予我们神圣的智慧。
label.en: It could teach us of the Divine.

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.en: Spiritualist

texts.zh: 在击败了神秘堡垒之后，它的一个舱段漂浮在太空中，我们决定将其带回[Target.Solar_System.GetName]，成为我们[Owner.GetParadeStudy]的一部分。一些[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在进入神秘堡垒舱室深处后都失踪了。自它运抵[Target.GetName]时，我们每天都派出[Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural]进入探索，但今天早些时候它内部的某些结构发生了变化。舱门自发地折叠消失了，只留下无尽的舱壁嘲笑着我们的工作人员们的狂怒。我们仍能与被困的[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]取得联络，但我们目前没有想出能不破坏该结构为前提的营救方案。看来神秘堡垒还有最后一个未解之谜。
texts.en: After defeating the Enigmatic Fortress, a section of it was floating in space, so we decided to bring it to [Target.Solar_System.GetName] to be a part of our [Owner.GetParadeStudy]. Several [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have gone missing inside the depths of the Chamber from the Fortress. Ever since it arrived on [Target.GetName], we have had [Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural] exploring it daily, yet something inside the structure shifted earlier today. Doors folded in on themselves, leaving only sheer walls for our agents to rail against. We can still communicate with the trapped [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but we have no clear idea of getting them out without damaging the structure. It seems that the Enigmatic Fortress had one last secret.

label.en: Leave no [Owner.GetSpeciesName] behind!

tooltips.zh: 这将会降低该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will reduce the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.zh: 我们承担不起切割舱室的代价。
label.en: We can't risk despoiling the Chamber.

label.zh: 我们可以用这个方法来关押罪大恶极之人。
label.en: We could use this technology to contain our undesirables.

tooltips.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
tooltips.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

label.zh: 我们可以用这个方法来关押罪大恶极之人。
label.en: We could use this technology to contain our undesirables.
Authoritarian

label.zh: 把这个舱室做成一个密室逃脱游戏让游行参与者来玩。
label.en: Set the structure up as a puzzle room for parade-goers to explore.
Gestalt Consciousness
Authoritarian
Discover the chamber's secrets!
Gestalt Consciousness

texts.zh:
虚空孳孽毒腺中的污染物发生了严重泄露！这些毁灭性的毒液已经污染了我们[Target.GetName]的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]资源，迫使我们从其他的星球运输[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]来缓解这场自作自受的大干旱。这种演化出来用以杀死硕大无朋的巨型太空兽群、溶穿厚重装甲板的毒液对任何不慎摄入的[Owner.GetSpeciesName]来说都剧毒无比。我们现在得研究如何解决这场危机。

我们是要在[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]从分子层面上净化掉所有虚空孳孽的基因，或是慢慢地将这些毒液过滤掉，以继续进行我们的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]？
texts.en:
The containment for the Voidspawn's Venom Gland has sprung a leak! The devastating venom has now poisoned our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply on [Target.GetName], forcing us to ferry [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] from other worlds to alleviate the self-imposed drought. The venom, which evolved to incapacitate titanic Space Fauna and melt through hull plating, has proven to be incredibly toxic to any [Owner.GetSpeciesName] that has ingested it. We now must decide how to handle this crisis.

Do we perform a molecular purge of all Voidspawn DNA on our [Target.GetPlanetHabitat], or do we slowly filter the venom out so that we can proceed with the [Owner.GetParadeStudy]?

texts.zh:
虚空孳孽毒腺中的污染物发生了严重泄露！这些毁灭性的毒液已经污染了我们[Target.GetName]的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]资源，迫使我们从其他的星球运输[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]来缓解这场自作自受的大干旱。这种演化出来用以杀死硕大无朋的巨型太空兽群、溶穿厚重装甲板的毒液对任何不慎接触的[Owner.GetSpeciesName]沉积岩皮来说都具有极强的腐蚀性。我们现在得研究如何解决这场危机。

我们是要在[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]从分子层面上净化掉所有虚空孳孽的基因，或是慢慢地将这些毒液过滤掉，以继续进行我们的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]？

The containment for the Voidspawn's Venom Gland has sprung a leak! The devastating venom has now poisoned our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply on [Target.GetName], forcing us to ferry [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] from other worlds to alleviate the self-imposed drought. The venom, which evolved to incapacitate titanic Space Fauna and melt through hull plating, has proven to be incredibly corrosive to any [Owner.GetSpeciesName] that got it on their sedimentary skin. We now must decide how to handle this crisis.

Do we perform a molecular purge of all Voidspawn DNA on our [Target.GetPlanetHabitat], or do we slowly filter the venom out so that we can proceed with the [Owner.GetParadeStudy]?

texts.zh:
虚空孳孽毒腺中的污染物发生了严重泄露！这些毁灭性的毒液已经污染了我们[Target.GetName]的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]资源，迫使我们从其他的星球运输[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]来缓解这场自作自受的大干旱。这种演化出来用以杀死硕大无朋的巨型太空兽群、溶穿厚重装甲板的毒液即时混进我们的冷却剂以后都是极具腐蚀性的。任何使用了这些受污染的冷却剂的单位都会立刻停止运转。我们现在得研究如何解决这场危机。

我们是要在[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]从分子层面上净化掉所有虚空孳孽的基因，或是慢慢地将这些毒液过滤掉，以继续进行我们的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]？
texts.en:
The containment for the Voidspawn's Venom Gland has sprung a leak! The devastating venom has now poisoned our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply on [Target.GetName], forcing us to ferry [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] from other worlds to alleviate the self-imposed drought. The venom, which evolved to incapacitate titanic Space Fauna and melt through hull plating, has proven to interact corrosively when exposed to our coolant. Any units using the contaminated coolant quickly stopped functioning. We now must decide how to handle this crisis.

Do we perform a molecular purge of all Voidspawn DNA on our [Target.GetPlanetHabitat], or do we slowly filter the venom out so that we can proceed with the [Owner.GetParadeStudy]?

label.zh: 控制污染的扩散，保障[Owner.GetParadeStudy]继续进行。
label.en: Contain the spread but don't cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy].

tooltips.zh: 在污染清理干净之后再举办[Owner.GetParadeStudy]。
tooltips.en: Pause the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] until the contaminant is cleared up.

label.zh: 把污染物和那个毒腺一并清理出去！
label.en: Cleanse the world of the contaminant and the venom sack!

tooltips.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以尽快清理这颗星球。
tooltips.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of quickly cleaning the world.

label.en: Machine Intelligence
Machine Intelligence

texts.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]给养被虚空孳孽的酸性毒液污染了。
texts.en: Our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply has been contaminated with the acidic venom from the Voidspawn.

texts.zh: 在几个月的努力后，我们在[Target.GetName]上的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]资源终于移除了虚空孳孽污染变得清洁可用。这并不是徒劳一场，反之，我们在[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]中学到了许多异星生理学的基本知识，并且已经准备好继续进行[Owner.GetParadeStudy]。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为，只要[Owner.GetParadeStudy]的研究得出结果，他们就能以其提升[Target.GetName]的生活质量。
texts.en: After many months of effort, our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply on [Target.GetName] is finally clear of the Voidspawn Contaminant. It was not a wasted effort, as we have learned much from the xeno-biology present in our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] and are now ready to proceed with the [Owner.GetParadeStudy]. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] now think that they can improve life on [Target.GetName] with the these discoveries once the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] concludes.

label.en: Excellent.

texts.zh: 我们遗留在噬星者最终被击杀的地方的探测器汇报，那具遗骸的一部分开始和恒星融为一体。释放的能量增进了恒星活动，但我们的计算表明，由于移除了卵鞘，这仍不足以让[dead_stellarite.solar_system.GetName]恒星系恢复原有的光明。如果我们让货运飞船返回，我们有希望可以重新点亮这颗恒星。
texts.en: The observation probes we had left behind at the site of the Stellar Devourer's final demise report that portions of the body have started to merge back into the star. The energy seems to have increased stellar activity, but with the removal of the Egg Sac, our calculations state that it won't be enough to restore the [dead_stellarite.solar_system.GetName] system to its former luster. If we turn our transport ship back now, we could still potentially reignite the star.

label.zh: 归还卵鞘，并看看我们能做些什么。
label.en: Return the Egg Sac and see what can be done.

tooltips.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以尝试重新点亮[dead_stellarite.system.GetName]。
tooltips.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of attempting to reignite the [dead_stellarite.system.GetName] star.

label.en: No, we are bringing the Egg Sac to [Target.GetName].

texts.zh: 吞食恒星的怪物被击杀了，它的尸体依然散发着最近被它所吞噬的恒星的能源。对它进行解剖也许能够让我们揭秘它是如何消化宇宙中最热的物体的。
texts.en: The star consumer has been slain, its body still radiating the energy from the star it last fed on. Studying it might reveal the secrets of how it is capable of digesting the warmest objects in the universe.

texts.zh:
对噬星者闪烁的遗体进行研究后，我们的科学家感到既困惑又惊奇。这个以恒星为食的生命体本身就是一个微型聚变炉，通过吞噬恒星物质从而将其转化成自身的能源。

由于尸体中还残留大量之前从[guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]恒星系获取的恒星物质，我们可以萃取这些能源并重新点亮恒星。或者也可以将尸体中的热量收为己用，在短期内满足我们的能源需求，但这会导致该恒星系陷入永久的冰期。
texts.en:
Studies of the Stellar Devourer's shining remains have left our scientists perplexed and amazed. The star-feasting being is itself a miniature fusion furnace, harvesting solar matter to synthesize an energy source of its own.

Since the body still contains significant amounts of solar matter from the star of the [guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName] system, the one it last fed from, it could be possible to extract the energy and reinvigorate the star. Harvesting the corpse's heat for our own ends could satisfy our energy needs in the short term, but would doom the system to an eternal ice age.

texts.zh:
对噬星者闪烁的遗体进行研究后，我们感到既困惑又惊奇。这个以恒星为食的生命体本身就是一个微型聚变炉，通过吞噬恒星物质从而将其转化成自身的能源。

由于尸体中还残留大量之前从[guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]恒星系获取的恒星物质，我们可以萃取这些能源并重新点亮恒星。或者也可以将尸体中的热量收为己用，在短期内满足我们的能源需求，但这会导致该恒星系陷入永久的冰期。
texts.en:
Studies of the Stellar Devourer's shining remains leave us perplexed and amazed. The star-feasting being is itself a miniature fusion furnace, harvesting solar matter to synthesize an energy source of its own.

Since the body still contains significant amounts of solar matter from the star of the [guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName] system, the one it last fed from, it could be possible to extract the energy and reinvigorate the star. Harvesting the corpse's heat for our own ends could satisfy our energy needs in the short term, but would doom the system to an eternal ice age.

label.en: Try to reignite the star.
Harvest the body's energy deposits.
Gestalt Consciousness
Gestalt Consciousness

texts.zh: 彻底研究过这个噬星者后，我们找到了一个方法可以将被吞噬的恒星恢复成初始形态，让这个陷入了寒冬的恒星系重新感受到恒星的温暖。
texts.en: After having studied the stellar devourer we've found a way to maybe return the consumed star mass to its point of origin, restoring the warmth to the system now stuck in an eternal winter.

texts.zh: 项目成功了！将噬星者的遗骸没入[guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]的恒星后，恒星的火焰恢复高涨。恒星系内的各个行星逐渐回暖，并随着生态系统的重建恢复成了过去的样子。其中一颗冰封星球解冻，露出了盖亚星球，富饶的土地完全适于殖民。
texts.en: The project was a success! Submerging the Stellar Devourer's remains in the [guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName] system's star has stoked the flames of the solar furnace. The planets in the system are heating up, reverting to their past forms as their ecologies recover. Among them was a frozen world, now thawing to reveal a Gaia world, ripe and ready for colonization.

texts.zh:
实施这项计划获得了回报，但也付出了不小的代价。将噬星者的遗骸沉入[guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]的恒星之中后，恒星的燃烧似乎变得剧烈了，但也喷发出火焰吞噬了[Root.GetName]和上面的船员。所有人无一生还。

恒星系中行星的温度快速回升，已经接近这些行星原本的温度。
texts.en:
The project has paid off, but at a cost. Submerging the Stellar Devourer's remains into [guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]'s star has caused the solar furnace to shine a bit brighter, but also to spew out solar flares that engulfed the [Root.GetName] and its crew in a roaring inferno. There were no survivors.
The planets in the system are heating up, reaching temperature levels closer to their original form.

label.en: Excellent.

tooltips.zh:
变更[guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]星系内所有行星的类型。

[stellarite_rich_planet.GetName]成为盖亚星球。
tooltips.en:
Changes the planet classes of all planets within the [guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName] system.

[stellarite_rich_planet.GetName] becomes a Gaia planet.

label.en: Unfortunate.

tooltips.zh:
[Root.GetName]已被摧毁。

变更[guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]星系内所有行星的类型。

[stellarite_rich_planet.GetName]成为苔原星球。
tooltips.en:
The [Root.GetName] is destroyed.

Changes the planet classes of all planets within the [guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName] system.

[stellarite_rich_planet.GetName] becomes a Tundra planet.

texts.zh:
这一天终于来临。我们的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]已经就位，准备为我们对[This.GetTrophyName]进行全面的探索。随着研究的开始，我们将一小部分意识集中在[Target.GetName]上，以消化吸收对异常项目的研究。然而，让我们将残余物拖到[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]以后发现，结果并不如我们希望的那么有趣。

就在这项进程开始之后不久，我们决定将研究转移到位于[Target.GetName]的中央团簇，由特化的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]对其进行持续观测。希望能从中有更多的发现。
texts.en:
The day has arrived. Our [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] were in place and ready to give us a thorough exploration of the [This.GetTrophyName]. As the study, began a small portion of our consciousness focused on [Target.GetName] to absorb the study of the anomalous item. However, the revelations were not as interesting as we had hoped as we dragged the remains to the [Target.GetPlanetHabitat].

Shortly after the process began, we decided to move the study to the center of our cluster on [Target.GetName], where the specialized [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] will continuously observe it. Hopefully something more will come of it.

texts.zh:
这一天终于来临。我们的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]已经就位，准备为我们对[This.GetTrophyName]进行全面的探索。随着研究的开始，我们将一小部分意识集中在[Target.GetName]上，以消化吸收对异常项目的研究。当天，整个[Owner.GetName]的产出率整整降低了0.2%。

探测数据被深深映在我们的意识当中，并转移到到位于[Target.GetName]的中央团簇，由特化的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]对其进行持续观测。
texts.en:
The day has arrived. Our [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] were in place and ready to give us a thorough exploration of the [This.GetTrophyName]. As the study began, a significant portion of our consciousness focused on [Target.GetName] to absorb the import of this anomalous item. Productivity in the [Owner.GetName] was reduced by a whole 0.2% for the day.

The sensory data was then archived deep in our consciousness before being placed in the center of our cluster on [Target.GetName], where the specialized [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] will continuously observe it.

texts.zh:
这一天终于来临。大量[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]已经就位，准备为我们对[This.GetTrophyName]进行切实的探索。随着研究的开始，我们将整个意识集中在[Target.GetName]上，以消化吸收对这一令我们全神贯注的异常项目的研究。几个危险境地的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]因一时分神而受伤，甚至还有几个失踪了。我们对此无比痴迷。

在初步研究完成后，我们决定将其转移到到位于[Target.GetName]的中央团簇，由特化的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]对其进行持续观测。我们近乎虔诚地部署了这一研究任务，并持续分配一部分意识对其进行观测。
texts.en:
The day has arrived. A massive amount of [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] were in place and ready to give us an exacting exploration of the [This.GetTrophyName]. As the study began, for a moment, our entire consciousness focused on [Target.GetName] to absorb the study of the anomalous item which preoccupied us so. Several [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] caught up in precarious situations were injured in the momentary distraction, and a few were even lost. So great was our fascination.

After the initial study was complete, we decided to move it to the center of our cluster on [Target.GetName], where the specialized [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] will continuously observe it. We placed it down, almost reverently, and continue to dedicate a part of our consciousness to the observation.

label.en: Disappointing Results.
We will remember the [This.GetLeviathanTargetName].

label.zh: 在[This.GetTrophyName]中，我们重新认识了自己。
label.en: In the [This.GetTrophyName], we have found ourselves.

texts.zh: 此前的传言一语成谶了：[This.GetName]上的恐怖负相物质正在我们的现实上撕开裂口，打开通向另一个世界裂隙。这一现象突破了抑制措施，开始在[This.GetName]上蔓延。所有与这一维度接触的事物，哪怕是不经意地透过观测设备查看，都让进行观察的[Owner.GetTeamMember]感受到剧烈的痛苦。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]担忧事态还可能进一步扩大，但同时保证只要再花一点时间他们就能解开另一个维度的奥秘了。
texts.en: What was only rumors before has now been confirmed: the Horrific Inverse Mass on [This.GetName] has been tearing holes in our very reality, opening rifts into another world. The phenomenon has breached the containment procedures and now seems to be expanding into [This.GetName]'s capital. Any contact with the dimension, even inadvertently through the lens of observational devices, causes intense distress on the observing [Owner.GetTeamMember]. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are worried that his can spread even further but also promise that with just a bit more time they can unlock the secrets of the other dimension.

texts.zh: 此前的传言一语成谶了：[This.GetName]上的恐怖负相物质正在我们的现实上撕开裂口，打开通向一个纯粹邪恶世界的裂隙。任何窥视裂隙的人都会立刻陷入疯狂，直到数个小时之后才停止尖叫。我们的牧师们长年以来都在思考着我们所击败的这一实体的存在而一无所获，如今却说他们即将顿悟了。“再给我们点时间吧！”他们恳求，然而我们的科学家警告，如果再不加以控制，事态可能会变得不可收拾。
texts.en: What was only rumors before has now been confirmed; the Horrific Inverse Mass on [This.GetName] has been tearing holes in our very reality into a world of pure evil. Anyone even glancing towards one of the rifts needs hours of solitude just to stop screaming. As our priests have been contemplating the very existence of the being we defeated for several years now without any great epiphany, they say that they are approaching one now. "We just need a bit more time!" They implore, while our scientist warn us that the process might be irreversible if we allow it to go on much further.

label.en: The discoveries are worth the risk!

label.zh: 我们需要见到真正的神圣视界。
label.en: We need to see the true vision of the Divine.

label.zh: 我们需要见到真正的神圣视界。
label.en: We need to see the true vision of the Divine.

label.zh: 我们必须学会恶咒才能击败它。
label.en: We must know the Anathema to defeat it.
No, the danger is too great.

texts.zh: 可能我们狂妄自大过了头。尽管在[This.GetName]上的恐怖负相物质仍封存良好，但整颗行星还是在被它从内而外逐渐撕碎。虽然我们在研究其他维度时获得的科学突破是革命性的，但它对行星的负担同样不可承受。尽管几乎没有[Owner.GetScientistPlural]有信心能控制住反应，但这并不是完全没有机会！在[This.GetName]的居民正在逐渐登船离开[This.GetPlanetHabitat]时，无数的空间裂口张开了。很快事态将会变得不可挽回。
texts.en: Perhaps our hubris was too great. [This.GetName] is being ripped apart from the inside as the Horrific Inverse Mass is still sequestered on it. While the breakthroughs we have had in the sciences from studying the other dimension are revolutionary, its strain on the world has been immense. Few [Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe that they can still stabilize the reaction, but there is a chance! As inhabitants of [This.GetName] board transport ships to leave the [This.GetPlanetHabitat], an innumerable amount of rifts are opening up. The point of no return is fast approaching.

texts.zh: 可能我们狂妄自大过了头。尽管在[This.GetName]上的恐怖负相物质仍封存良好，但整颗行星还是在被它从内而外逐渐撕碎。虽然我们对这个纯粹痛苦的维度有了许多了解，但它对行星的负担同样不可承受。几乎没有牧师敢保证自己能净化这团物质，但并不是完全没有机会！在[This.GetName]的居民正在逐渐登船离开[This.GetPlanetHabitat]时，无数的空间裂口张开了。很快事态将会变得不可挽回。
texts.en: Perhaps our hubris was too great. [This.GetName] is being ripped apart from the inside as the Horrific Inverse Mass is still sequestered on it. While we have learned much about the dimension of pure pain, the strain on the world has been immense. Few priests still believe that they purify the mass, but there is a chance! As inhabitants of [This.GetName] board transport ships to leave the [This.GetPlanetHabitat], an innumerable amount of rifts are opening up. The point of no return is fast approaching.

label.zh: 我们做得太过头了，恐怕已经无力回天。
label.en: We have come too far to see it end now.

label.zh: 如果我们就此止步就是向恶咒认输！
label.en: If we stop now the Anathema wins!
Get rid of it, by any means necessary!
Fanatic Materialist

texts.zh: 晴空永远消失了，它不是被乌云荫蔽，而是被纯粹的虚空所笼罩。[This.GetName]所残存的只有漂浮在虚无之海的陆地碎片。所有来不及逃离[This.GetPlanetHabitat]的人在其上的每一刻都在承受着无上的痛苦。我们为专家们争取到了尽可能多的时间。一个扭曲而恼人的声音回响在行星的上空：“对寸——回—回归于我——吧。”
texts.en: The sky is gone. It's not covered by clouds. It has been replaced by a pure void. All that remains of [This.GetName] is patches of ground in the ocean of nothingness. Everyone left on the [This.GetPlanetHabitat] is suffering pure agony for every instant that passes. We have bought as much time as we could for our specialists. A distorted and disturbed voice echoes from the world beyond "YesS re-reTURN to mee-."

label.en: It's now or never, [Owner.GetScientistPlural]!
It's now or never, [Owner.GetScientistPlural]!
Spiritualist
It's now or never, priests!
Spiritualist

texts.zh:
今天，[Target.GetName]首都的人群们迎来了阴沉的一天。游行的队伍携带着我们摧毁[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]的证明，漫步经过叽叽喳喳的围观者。这一过程在全帝国范围内广播，但反响极低，[This.GetTrophyName]似乎没有我们预想的那么令人感兴趣。

在完成了环球展览之后，[This.GetTrophyName]被放在了首都中心进行特展，以激励我们以及子孙后代。
texts.en:
An overcast day greeted the middling crowd on [Target.GetName]'s capital city today. The procession carrying our proof of the destruction of the [This.GetLeviathanTargetName] ambled past the meandering onlookers. Its progress was broadcast throughout our empire, but engagement was low as the [This.GetTrophyName] did not seem to be quite as enticing as we had hoped.

After finishing the world tour, the [This.GetTrophyName] was placed in a specialized display at the center of the capital to inspire generations to come.

texts.zh:
今天，[Target.GetName]首都的拥挤人群们迎来了阳光明媚的一天。游行的队伍携带着我们摧毁[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]的证明，四处环游逐一展览。游行的过程在全帝国范围内数十亿观众直播。[This.GetTrophyName]一时成为了[Owner.Species.GetAdj]文化的重要象征，激发着全[Owner.GetName]的艺术家和发明家们。

在完成了环球展览之后，[This.GetTrophyName]被放在了首都中心进行特展，以激励我们以及子孙后代。
texts.en:
A bright day greeted the packed crowds on [Target.GetName] today as the procession carrying our proof of the destruction of the [This.GetLeviathanTargetName] traveled around. The parade's progress was broadcast throughout our empire to billions of viewers. The [This.GetTrophyName] already seems to have become a staple of [Owner.Species.GetAdj] culture, inspiring artists and creators across [Owner.GetName].

After finishing the world tour, the [This.GetTrophyName] was placed in a specialized display at the center of the capital to inspire generations to come.

texts.zh: 今天，[Target.GetName]晴空万里令人心旷神怡，不过这是理所当然的，因为我们把大气调控系统已经满负荷开到爆了。在这伟大的一天，[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]上的每座城市的大街小巷都挤得满满当当，而更多的商旅飞船仍在不断地停泊进行星的轨道。盛大的游行逐一经过每一个定居点，迎接他们的是人山人海的街道和[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]们热情的欢呼。我们帝国中每一座能够进行大型全息投影的城市也都挤满了观看盛大全息转播的观众。作为典礼的重中之重，[This.GetTrophyName]抵达了[Target.GetName]的首都，人们已经讨论起了将今天定为每年的[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]节日。在完成了环球展览之后，[This.GetTrophyName]被放在了首都中心进行特展，以激励我们以及子孙后代。
texts.en: The weather on [Target.GetName] was unnaturally great today, as it should have been, considering we ran our atmosphere control system on overdrive. Every city on the [Target.GetPlanetHabitat] reached its capacity, and there were still tourist ships orbiting the world just to be a part of this great day. The grand parade traveled through each settlement in turn, and was greeted by streets packed with [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Every city capable of requisitioning a holo-display in our empire was also overflowing with spectators for the grand hologram rebroadcasts. As the centerpiece of the parade, the [This.GetTrophyName], reached [Target.GetName]'s capital, people were already talking about making today a yearly [This.GetLeviathanTargetName] inspired holiday. The [This.GetTrophyName] was then placed in a specialized display at the center of the capital to inspire generations to come.

label.zh: 又没人来看嚷嚷着办什么庆典啊？
label.en: If they won't to show up for it, why did they ask for a celebration?
Today was a good day for all [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
We stand united today, as one.
